input.rationale: The Agreement contains no indemnification, defence or hold-harmless language anywhere: Section 9 (Warranties) carries only mutual corporate authority representations and a Globix carve-out, and Section 10 (General Provisions) moves straight to boilerplate; searches for "indemnify", "hold harmless", "defend" and "infringe" return nothing, and there is no limitation-of-liability provision either. HDI designs, develops, hosts and operates the Site, so the absence of any HDI indemnity for third-party IP infringement or its own misconduct is walk-away territory under this rule. We therefore insert a preferred-level HDI indemnity after the warranty section (before Section 10), with the customary notice/control/cooperation procedure and a Company indemnity confined to Company-provided Content and our own breach of law. We targeted preferred rather than fallback because the deal has no "annual fees" construct (payments are a share of Net Sales), making a 3x annual fees super-cap unworkable, and preferred avoids capping our recovery.

proposal.summary: Insert an HDI indemnity (IP infringement, breach of law, data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct) with standard procedure and a narrow Company indemnity.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnity at all, so we added an HDI indemnity covering third-party IP infringement claims relating to the Site and Services, HDI's breach of law, HDI-caused data breaches and HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with customary notice, control and cooperation mechanics and a Company indemnity limited to our Content and our breach of law.

ops.text: Indemnification. (a) HDI shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless the Company and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Site, the Services or any deliverable provided by HDI infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (ii) HDI's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of the Company's data or Confidential Information caused by HDI; or (iv) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. (b) The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any such claim, the indemnifying Party shall have control of the defense and settlement of the claim, and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation in the defense of the claim. (c) The Company shall defend and indemnify HDI against third-party claims to the extent arising out of the Content provided by the Company or the Company's breach of applicable law.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
